title: Negative (artifact warning): a plug-flow reactor makes the layered CIPS world reach labkit generation 16, but the generations are buds shed by one body anchored at the inlet, not repeated division of free bodies
summary: Aim: let births continue past the box-fill limit of the layered CIPS condensates. world.py = the low-noise layered world (20261026T1626-c44-cips-lownoise-gen4-claim) plus a uniform flow vflow along x carrying every field (exact Fourier shift each step) and an outlet strip x<6 where e relaxes to e0 and p, s to 0 (washout of bodies, fresh medium in). 128x128, seed 0, t=30000. vflow 0.02: 52 persistent splits, max generation 16, 40 merges; vflow 0.01: 25 persistent splits, generation 6, 18 merges. The images show why: the medium leaving the outlet carries enzyme at e0, richer than the depleted bath, so a large body forms and stays anchored just downstream of the inlet (x~6-25 in every frame of sheet_v002.png and strip_v002.png) and keeps pinching off daughters that drift downstream to the outlet. labkit's persistent-split rule gives both children a new id at generation+1, so each bud raises the anchored lineage's generation by one. It is a budding niche fed by the inflow, not free bodies dividing repeatedly; the merges come from the anchored structure re-absorbing its buds.

finding.operator: plug flow with an outlet strip (washout) in cooperative CIPS on a consumed, regrowing fuel
finding.control: same world without flow (17-18 bodies, generation 3-4, then no births)
finding.result: vflow 0.02: labkit generation 16 and 52 persistent splits, but generated by an inlet-anchored body budding; vflow 0.01: generation 6

limits: One seed, 128x128, two flow speeds; WORLD_P {"vflow":0.02,"out_w":6}. Resetting the outlet to the bath value instead of e0 would remove the inlet enrichment but then nothing replaces the bodies a plug flow carries out; a well-mixed (random) washout is the cleaner chemostat analogue and is being tried next. Generation counts from labkit's lineage on growing or budding structures should be checked against images.
